prompt: Reductive ozonolysis of 2-methyl-2-butene (O3; then DMS). Draw BOTH organic products.
explanation: O3 cleaves the C=C into two C=O groups. The CH of the alkene becomes an aldehyde (acetaldehyde); the fully substituted C becomes a ketone (acetone). DMS workup stops at the aldehyde/ketone (H2O2 workup would push 1° to COOH).
